verdict.rationale: LangSmith dashboards track token usage and cost, and charts can be grouped by run tag or metadata to split data over application attributes, which covers attributing usage to users or features. Cost-threshold alerts and thread views add cost tracking and session context. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that cost and token charts break down by metadata keys such as user_id or session_id, detail on attaching custom metadata to traces, and independent or hands-on corroboration of per-user or per-feature cost attribution.
